name: Saitou Seiji
source: A very handsome young man. All the maids at the Black Cat Maid Café seem to find him incredibly handsome, but he has his sights set on the new maid - Itoshi. Not only is he hot, he is also quite successful as a music producer. Would you let Saito scout you?
